reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here shows reviews, a Trustpilot score or a track record, so I'd be paying $360 to a store I can't verify. I'd save the pendant to my dining room board and keep looking at brands I can check.
objection: Is it UL listed, and will my electrician actually install it? Nothing says so. And I can't tell if this store is legit, with no reviews and a 6 week wait on made-to-order pieces. If the light arrives wrong I'd also pay return shipping on something big and fragile.
would_change_my_mind: Hundreds of independent reviews with customer photos (Trustpilot or similar), a clear UL/ETL listing on the product page, and free returns or a damaged-in-transit guarantee.
